history.content: hey. i dont really know why im here honestly. just been feeling kind of off
Hey, that off feeling is here with you, even if the reason isn’t clear yet. We can just sit with it for a moment, if you want.
i dunno. its not really off like sad exactly. more like i keep looking at whats coming next and theres just. nothing there. like a blank wall
I had that wrong, let me step back. Does it feel more blank, or more like you’re staring at something blocked off?

blocked off i think. i finish my contract in like 8 weeks and i havent lined anything up. everyone keeps asking whats next and i just. i used to have a plan for everything and now i open my laptop to job sites and close it again

That sounds like the blank wall has a reason now, the “what’s next” question and not having a plan in place. It makes sense that opening the laptop and closing it again would come with that blocked-off feeling.
its not even the pressure really. like its sad more than anything. i was the person who always knew where i was going. and that person is just. gone? i miss her. its dumb
That doesn’t sound dumb. It sounds like you’re missing the version of you who always knew where you were going, and that has a grief to it.

yeah. grief. thats the word. i didnt expect to feel like im mourning something thats not even a person. its just a future i thought id have. i keep waiting to feel motivated and instead i just feel like crying at my desk
Yeah, it’s a future you thought you’d have, and now it leaves you at your desk feeling like crying. I’m here if you want to stay with that a little longer, or we can leave it here.
i think i wanna leave it there for now. i dont have answers tonight and thats ok i guess. it helped to just. say it out loud. thank you. gonna close the laptop. the right way this time
That feels like a good place to stop, and I’m glad saying it out loud helped. Closing the laptop can be enough for tonight.
